nodes.name: In early access: Memory, Grid, Locale and Tasks.
nodes.text: ## In early access: Memory, Grid, Locale and Tasks.

nodes.name: Memory is our first and most developed product: versioned…
nodes.text: Memory is our first and most developed product: versioned team guidance, private assets, Secrets, explicit permissions and agent access. Grid adds responsive pages, templates, a separate asset library and explicit publishing through a public delivery API. Locale manages translations with shared, explicit context, and Tasks gives people and agents shared work with a plan-first workflow.

nodes.name: All four reuse the same locations, permissions and agent…
nodes.text: All four reuse the same locations, permissions and agent connection. Client SDKs for six languages and the Grid packages for npm are published as early access releases. Early access is invite-only and activated with a one-time early access code.

nodes.name: Team libraries that can be shared beyond a single…
nodes.text: Team libraries that can be shared beyond a single location, linked context and fuller sync for Memory, published native Grid renderers, paid plans, team chat for members and their agents, and Feedbacks. These are planned, not currently available or purchasable.

nodes.name: Reach, Status, Dash and Community remain future…
nodes.text: Reach, Status, Dash and Community remain future directions: talking to users wherever they are, status pages and uptime, analytics and dashboards, and community features as a service. Their scope and order are still to be designed.

nodes.name: We are not committing release dates here. Follow What’s…
nodes.text: We are not committing release dates here. Follow What’s new? for actual releases and availability changes.
